tasks.title: Live check of cell_registry.py reconcile in the bakeoff world
tasks.notes: reconcile (task 44) is tested only with fakes. With the bakeoff world open and MCP up, on a throwaway patch (e.g. the 4x4 ghost patch at x 6128-6131, z -5546..-5543 in cell 47,-44; use stage 'other' applies): (1) `cell_registry.py reconcile` on a healthy world exits 0 and prints clean, also `reconcile 47,-44`; (2) break one planned block with a block_fill_batch (air, then another block); dry run exits 1, shows missing/foreign with the right want/got sample, changes no blocks, writes no journal line, claims no lock; (3) `reconcile 47,-44 --fix` re-fills, exits 0, a rerun is clean, the journal gains a `repair` line; (4) crash an apply between fills and Ticket.finish (patch cell_journal.Ticket.finish to raise): `site_recover.py status` and `reconcile` both show it in flight, and recover lands or rolls back as before; (5) `reconcile --fix` with the lock held by another owner is refused with a SystemExit. Clean up test entries afterwards (CellRegistry.reset() archives the journal; delete any recover_test_* files). Nothing in this check copies or edits region files: blocks change over MCP only. Earlier session scripts are not kept; the old recover test is described in task 42's archive note.
